items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Oh, yeah, Carnes, I know him good. He was a big time piano player.

ctx.x: I just found a note about Al Wynn and Eddie Carnes. Carnes?
Carnes, Eddie Carnes. Oh, that's a piano player, Eddie Carnes. Yeah. Yeah, he was a piano player in Chicago.
